qualification.details: Site Engineer: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from an AICTE-approved University / Institute. Minimum 3 years and less than 5 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector. Project Engineer: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from an AICTE-approved University / Institute. Minimum 5 years and less than 10 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector. Architect: Full-time Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) from a recognised University / Institute, with valid registration with the Council of Architecture (COA). Minimum 5 years and less than 10 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector.

selection_process: Applications meeting all eligibility criteria shall be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates shall be informed exclusively through registered e-mail or WAPCOS website.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WAPCOS to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: WAPCOS Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications meeting all eligibility criteria shall be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates shall be informed exclusively through registered e-mail or WAPCOS website.

content_sections.heading: WAPCOS How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WAPCOS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WAPCOS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Water and Power Consultancy Services (WAPCOS) for technical manpower positions in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies have been announced for Site Engineer, Project Engineer, and Architect posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Site Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering from an AICTE-approved University or Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Engineer position is 45 years as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the nature of the job offered by WAPCOS?
faq.answer: The job is purely on a temporary contract basis for an initial period of 11 months, which may be extended based on project requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the recruitment application.

faq.question: Q8. How will the candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected based on the shortlisting of applications that meet all the necessary eligibility and experience criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the printed copy of the online application be sent?
faq.answer: The printed copy of the submitted application along with supporting documents must be sent by Speed Post or Registered Post to the designated WAPCOS address.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to access the online application form?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can access the online application portal by visiting the official WAPCOS website at www.wapcos.co.in.
